name: claude-history
description: Local web browser for all Claude Code conversations across all projects

scripts.stop: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p = if ($env:PORT) { [int]$env:PORT } else { 7434 }; if ($p -eq 7433) { throw 'Port 7433 belongs to the installed release. Stop it from Task Scheduler, not from here.' }; Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $p -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force; Write-Host ('claude-history dev stopped (pid ' + $_ + ')') }"
